verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a processor (hardware SoC). Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a software/OS or orchestration-platform capability, so this story is a category error for a chip. The surrounding software ecosystem (Ryzen AI SDK, Lemonade, GAIA agent framework) is documented, but nothing in the evidence shows any first-party scheduling or recurring-workflow feature that would make the axis apply.
